scope: Find a CVE reachable from PUBLIC unauthenticated surface OR escalatable from low-priv authenticated surface
framing: Hostile attacker model. Goals: (1) find any CVE chainable to RCE / data theft / NF525 fiscal-state tampering from outside the building. (2) Disprove benign-by-default assumptions of Architect+Security.
public_unauthenticated_surfaces_v1_lecay: https://lecayenne.fr (customer ordering website, root + menu + checkout)
Kiosk borne URL (in-store touchscreen, technically LAN-only but physically accessible to anyone)
/api/v1/* customer ordering endpoints (Sanctum kiosk:order ability, customer tokens)
/storage/* uploaded image direct delivery (if public disk symlinked)

red_team_attack_paths_attempted.name: Laravel CVE-2025-27515 file validation bypass — customer-facing path?
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.attack: Customer uploads polyglot image-PDF that passes 'image' mime check, gets served from /storage, browser executes embedded payload.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.finding: Customer-facing uploads do NOT exist in FoodKing surface. ItemPhoto/Coupon/Theme uploads are ADMIN-ONLY. CouponRequest has 'nullable' image but is admin-gated. No customer-side image upload path identified.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.verdict: NOT-EXPLOITABLE from public surface. Admin-authenticated only.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.residual_risk: Insider threat: rogue admin / branch manager could plant polyglot. Mitigated by single-resto Le Cayenne model (small admin team, owner-trusted).

red_team_attack_paths_attempted.name: axios prototype pollution via customer-controlled JSON
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.attack: Customer mobile/web app receives malicious response from MITM/compromised CDN that exploits axios __proto__ pollution → cascading auth bypass / response tampering.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.finding: FoodKing axios calls go to OWN backend (api.lecayenne.fr) over HTTPS. No third-party axios calls. MITM requires breaking HTTPS. Pollution requires server to return __proto__ key in response — Laravel does not. CHAIN BROKEN.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.verdict: NOT-EXPLOITABLE absent HTTPS break OR backend response tampering (which would be game-over anyway).
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.residual_risk: If customer adds malicious browser extension or visits compromised page first, prototype-pollution gadget on axios COULD persist into FoodKing session. Real but low-probability. FIX-PRE-PROD recommended regardless.

red_team_attack_paths_attempted.name: sweetalert2 8.19.1 supply-chain compromise
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.attack: GHSA-8jh9-wqpf-q52c affects sweetalert2 8.19.1+ specifically — 'hidden functionality' suggests malicious code shipped in published package. EVERY page loading vendor.js is exposed.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.finding: vendor.js IS shipped to every customer page (mobile + web + kiosk + admin). If the hidden functionality is data exfiltration / backdoor / cryptojacker, every visitor's browser executes it. This is a SUPPLY-CHAIN attack already armed.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.verdict: REACHABLE PUBLIC SURFACE — supply-chain CVE means the package itself contains the payload, no exploit required.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.residual_risk: CRITICAL category. MUST FIX PRE-PROD. Audit npm package contents OR upgrade to 8.19.2+ immediately.

red_team_attack_paths_attempted.name: swiper prototype pollution via customer-controlled URL params
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.attack: Customer-controlled URL params populate swiper config (e.g. slider hash navigation, image gallery indexes) → __proto__ injection → admin session hijack.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.finding: Inspected resources/js/components/frontend/home/SliderComponent.vue + ItemComponent.vue (admin POS) — swiper config is HARDCODED (slidesPerView, navigation, autoplay literal options). No user-input merge into config object. CHAIN BROKEN.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.verdict: NOT-EXPLOITABLE in current usage. Risk persists if future feature adds dynamic-config swiper.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.residual_risk: DEFER V1.0.X with note: any swiper config refactor MUST audit for user-input merge.

red_team_attack_paths_attempted.name: league/commonmark embed/raw-html bypass via customer-input markdown
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.attack: Customer review/comment/notification rendered as markdown → XSS payload bypasses sanitizer → admin browser executes JS → admin session hijack.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.finding: Grep zero matches for CommonMark / Str::markdown / convertToHtml in FoodKing app code. League/commonmark is transitive (Laravel mail rendering). No user-content markdown render path identified.

red_team_attack_paths_attempted.name: firebase JS SDK gRPC memory allocation DoS via FCM push
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.attack: Attacker spoofs FCM payload to allocate huge memory in customer browser → DoS.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.finding: FCM payloads originate from FoodKing backend (controlled). Attacker would need to compromise FCM project credentials (separate threat). gRPC memory allocation requires Firestore-streaming usage — FoodKing uses Firebase Messaging only, NOT Firestore. CHAIN BROKEN.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.residual_risk: If FoodKing adds Firestore data sync in V1.x, re-audit immediately.

red_team_attack_paths_attempted.name: phpseclib AES-CBC padding oracle via webhook/encryption
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.attack: Attacker probes any FoodKing endpoint that encrypts/decrypts using phpseclib AES-CBC → padding oracle leaks plaintext.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.finding: Grep zero matches for phpseclib / Crypt\\AES in FoodKing app code. FoodKing encryption = Laravel's openssl-based Encrypter (config/app.php APP_KEY). No phpseclib AES surface.

red_team_attack_paths_attempted.name: lodash _.template code injection via admin import file
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.attack: Admin imports Excel file → controller passes user content to _.template() somewhere → arbitrary JS executed in admin browser.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.finding: Grep lodash usage: heavy use of _.debounce / _.throttle / _.cloneDeep / _.merge across admin/POS/kiosk components. No _.template() call identified in spot check. Would need full audit to confirm zero usage.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.verdict: LIKELY-NOT-EXPLOITABLE but unverified. Conservative bump to 4.17.21+ closes it regardless.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.residual_risk: FIX-PRE-PROD is cheap (`npm audit fix` non-breaking).

red_team_attack_paths_attempted.name: Chained attack — axios prototype pollution + sweetalert2 supply chain
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.attack: sweetalert2 (already compromised) pollutes window.__proto__ → axios picks up polluted config → silent credential exfiltration to attacker server.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.finding: Theoretically possible but speculative without knowing exactly what sweetalert2 8.19.1's 'hidden functionality' is. The mere PRESENCE of a supply-chain CVE in a globally-loaded vendor.js is THE critical issue.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.verdict: REINFORCES RED-3 — sweetalert2 fix is non-negotiable.

red_team_attack_paths_attempted.name: Webhook surface — symfony/process Windows escape (Stripe webhook → exec on Windows dev)
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.attack: Stripe/SenangPay webhook triggers backend exec on Windows dev machine via symfony/process → command injection.
red_team_attack_paths_attempted.finding: FoodKing prod = Linux (Ansible/OVH plan). Dev = mixed. Windows CVE not reachable on Linux prod.

adversarial_disputes_to_security_finding.dispute: Security claims 'Laravel CVE-2025-27515 admin-only' — counter: insider threat / phishing → admin credentials compromised → exploit triggers.
adversarial_disputes_to_security_finding.resolution: Insider threat is real but mitigated by single-resto trust model. Laravel 9 EOL is the real structural issue, not single CVE scope.

adversarial_disputes_to_security_finding.dispute: Security claims 'swiper hardcoded config' — counter: dynamic-config refactor in V1.x could silently introduce attack surface.
adversarial_disputes_to_security_finding.resolution: Add to V1.0.X review checklist: any swiper config object that uses object-spread/Object.assign with user input MUST be audited.

adversarial_disputes_to_security_finding.dispute: Architect dismisses build-time CVEs — counter: malicious npm package in dev tree could compromise developer workstation → backdoor commit → prod compromise.
adversarial_disputes_to_security_finding.resolution: Build-time CVEs ARE NOT zero-risk in supply-chain era. Lower priority than prod-runtime but should still bump at convenience. NPM audit fix non-breaking covers most.

red_team_top_3_actual_concerns.rationale: GHSA-8jh9-wqpf-q52c labelled 'hidden functionality' = supply-chain compromise already shipped. Loaded on every page via vendor.js. FIX NOW.

Direct dep, 133 callsites, cumulative prototype-pollution + SSRF + DoS attack surface. Mostly not exploitable due to backend-controlled responses, but defense-in-depth principle + non-breaking fix = no reason not to bump.
EOL since Feb 2024. CVE-2025-27515 has NO 9.x fix. Even if exploit is admin-only insider-threat, running EOL framework is governance failure for production. Drives V1.1 migration urgency.

no_critical_unauthenticated_rce_found: After full adversarial sweep, NO chained CVE produces unauthenticated RCE on V1 Le Cayenne. sweetalert2 supply-chain remains the single 'no-exploit-needed' exposure. Everything else requires admin auth, MITM, or precondition not met.
